requiredBeforeActivation: Select and pin a specific ANP profile/specification release.
Bind a controlled HTTPS service origin and an appropriate DID method without altering the existing production identity.
Implement the selected ANP-02 authentication rules and corresponding method validation.
Generate a matching AgentDescription security configuration only after the receiver actually enforces it.
Validate discovery, authentication, rejection paths, expiry and replay behavior.
reason: A descriptor or did:wba label alone is not ANP authentication. No active security configuration is advertised by this package.
